title: CalcBar
description: In-game calculator with support for complex calculations
body:
# CalcBar [](https://modrinth.com/mod/calcbar) [](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/calcbar) ![video of the calcbar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6f0b728ac9686148662c677cbc1719c70896069.gif) ## Features - Supports common math operations like +, -, *, /, ^, parentheses, and more - Constants for common Minecraft calculations:
s = 1 stack = 64
hs = half stack = 32
qs = quarter stack = 16 - Supports SIN, COS, TAN, SQRT - Results update while you type
